intent: Plan a finance (cashflow) feature and the calendar → kanban → finance streamline, add its tasks, and update the board.
summary: Plan-mode session. Operator asked for a finance feature (inflow/outflow with categories, CRUD, RBAC, AI-friendly API, template components and icons) that streamlines event → task board → money. Found that events (M4) and boards (M5) have no link today, and that the activity log shows any row with board_id to every board member, which would leak amounts to members without finance permission. Wrote database-architecture/m10-finance.md (numeric(16,2) positive amounts with explicit direction, IDR, categories table with slugs, every entry on a board with optional event/task, boards.event_id, can_read_finance/can_write_finance RLS reusing is_board_member, finance activity logged without board_id plus a finance branch in the activity policy, agent_finance security-invoker view, pgTAP cases) and frontend-architecture/features/finance.md (user flow, five-file module, reused template parts, icons billing/trendingUp/trendingDown, get_finance tool contract). Linked both from system-overview.md, the database and frontend READMEs and agent-layer-mcp.md. Added Phase 10 with PSI-100 (this, review) and PSI-101…106 (backlog) with dependencies. Hermes was working in the main folder on task/PSI-081 with uncommitted task-list edits, so this was done in a temporary checkout in the system temp folder (operator's choice) and not in the main folder. No code or migration written.

decisions.decision: Add permission keys finance.read, finance.write, finance.manage (granted to admin)
decisions.reason: C-15/C-17 require a human yes for new keys. Operator's answer to the permissions question: "read / write / manage (Recommended)"

decisions.decision: Every finance entry belongs to a board; visibility = finance permission AND board membership (users or groups)
decisions.reason: Reuses the existing M5 group RBAC, which is the operator's 'tasking with RBAC (group) → financing' flow; no second sharing model

decisions.decision: Positive numeric(16,2) amount with explicit direction; IDR only; decimal strings in APIs
decisions.reason: Exact money and no sign ambiguity for people or LLMs

decisions.decision: Log finance activity without board_id and add a finance branch to the activity_log select policy
decisions.reason: The existing policy shows board rows to all members, which would leak amounts to members without finance.read

decisions.decision: Plan in a temporary checkout under the system temp folder
decisions.reason: Hermes was active in the main folder with uncommitted edits to docs/list-task-project.md; operator chose 'Temp workspace'
alternatives: Wait for Hermes to be idle
